topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 43 project-authored contract(s) across 5 chain(s); 4 ERC20 tokens, 3 ERC721 NFTs; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 9 functional families. Its contracts share 18 common project-authored base contract(s) (upgradeableproxy, proxy, zooerc20). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
